verdict.rationale: Community reports credit Vue with official CLI scaffolding (vue-cli) alongside its official router and store, and the docs list a Tooling Guide. That is a first-party CLI, but nothing shows it is designed for or documented around AI-native or agentic workflows, and the evidence is older community commentary rather than current docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the current official CLI and its commands, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (non-interactive or machine-readable output, agent integration), recent hands-on corroboration
